lines.text: Herod hears people say Jesus is John the Baptist risen from the dead, and Herod agrees.
Herod imprisoned John because John said it was unlawful for Herod to have his brother Philip's wife, Herodias.
Herodias wanted John dead, but Herod feared John and protected him, so she was unable to kill him.
At his birthday banquet, Herod promised the girl up to half his kingdom, and she asked her mother Herodias what to request.
An executioner beheaded John in the prison, and John's disciples took his body and laid it in a tomb.
